drafts.lead: Dana, Vibe NYC Tours — asked whether intros are warm, how we define qualified, booked vs held, no-shows, and for a profile link
drafts.body:
Dana,

Good questions, and you deserve direct answers rather than a brochure.

Are these warm introductions? No. We run cold outbound on your behalf. We build the list of school trip coordinators and corporate planners, set up separate sending domains so vibenyctours.com is never exposed, and email them as Vibe NYC Tours. We are not introducing you to people we already have relationships with, and anyone claiming otherwise is usually selling a list.

How do we define a qualified opportunity? A reply from someone at a fitting organisation who has decision-making input and expresses interest in talking. Not an open, not a click.

Does 10 to 30 mean booked or held? Neither. It means conversations started, replies from interested people that land in your inbox. Turning those into held meetings is the part you control, and I would rather tell you that now than have you find out in month two.

No-shows and unqualified prospects? We do not charge per meeting or per lead, so there is no incentive on our side to inflate the count. Unqualified replies get filtered before they reach you, and we tighten the targeting as we learn which segments actually convert for you.

Company: koldify.io, and the results section is the most useful part: https://koldify.io/#results

If you want to go through the targeting properly:

• Tuesday, August 11 at 1:30 PM EDT
• Wednesday, August 12 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Thursday, August 13 at 1:30 PM EDT

Morgan
